THE APPROPRIATION (RAILWAYS) No. 2 BILL, 2016
(AS PASSED BY THE HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT)
A
BILL
to authorise payment and appropriation of certain sums from and out of the Consolidated
Fund of India for the services of the financial year 2016-17 for the purposes of  Railways.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Sixty-seventh Year of the Republic of India as
follows:—
1. This Act may be called the Appropriation (Railways) No. 2  Act, 2016.
2. From and out of the Consolidated Fund of India there may be paid and applied sums
not exceeding those specified in column 3 of the Schedule amounting in the aggregate
[inclusive of the sums specified in column 3 of the Schedule to the Appropriation (Railways)
V ote on Account Act, 2016] to the sum of three lakh ninety-one thousand five hundred thirty-
eight crore, eighty-two lakh and nine thousand rupees towards defraying the several charges
which will come in course of payment during the financial year 2016-17, in respect of the
services relating to Railways specified in column 2 of the Schedule.

3. The sums authorised to be paid and applied from and out of the Consolidated Fund
of India by this Act shall be appropriated for the services and purposes expressed in the
Schedule in relation to the said year.
